thread:
Maya S.: Quick shoutout to Samir and Jules — they ran an impromptu "Buddy Day" this morning and basically saved onboarding for the new cohort. Set up sandboxes, nailed the quickstart, and shepherded the first demo. Massive 🙏
AJ: SO GOOD. those checklists are gold. :sparkles: :rocket:
Priya: Wow — heard about this from the new hires. they were actually able to finish the tutorial and join the Q&A. Sending stickers + coffee card. :coffee:
Samir: Team effort! Jules did the env fixes, AJ helped rewrite the quickstart steps, and Maya brought the morale (and the donuts). :doughnut: :grin:
Jules: Also added a 2-line troubleshooting tip to the doc that saved a 1hr rabbit hole: `If model fails at init, clear kv_cache && restart`. Pinned it to #docs.
AJ: Can we make that troubleshooting line into a small snippet in the DevEx kit? super useful.
DevEx Bot: created snippet "onboarding-troubleshoot-v1" and pinned to #devex-resources (automated).
Maya S.: @Priya can you add Samir + Jules to the kudos board? they deserve stickers and maybe a team lunch voucher.
Priya: On it — adding a kudos card and sending a $50 coffee card each. Also thinking of a small "buddy day" badge for swag.
Samir: lol badge would be adorable. also: if anyone wants the checklist it's in #docs -> "onboarding/buddy-day-checklist" (pinned).
AJ: Photo? they looked exhausted but proud. :camera_with_flash:
Maya S.: uploaded: https://files.redwood/casual/crew_sunday_morning.jpg (team huddle, sleepy but triumphant)
Jules: thanks everyone. felt good to make the ramp less scary for folks.
Priya: Official thank you note going out in the weekly roundup. :email: :star:
AJ: +1 to team lunch — my treat if we go somewhere that has good tacos. :taco: :raised_hands:
